title: Umphefumlo Onomonde Wendlu Engcwele
intro: Kwiphepha leQuran, kuvela umntu ovela kumnombo womprofeti omkhulu, onikwe njengesipho ebudaleni. Lo mphefumlo ubhiyozelwa ngenxa yokunyaniseka okungagungqiyo kunye nendima ebalulekileyo ekumiseni indawo engcwele eya kuba luphawu lokholo. Njengoko ufunda izikhokelo, mamela ngononophelo ilizwi elivela kwixesha elidlulileyo, kuba lithetha kumntu wokuqala.
clues: Ndikhankanywa kwiQuran kunye nomnye umprofeti njengesipho esinikwe umthunywa omdala.
Ndandingomnye wabantwana ababini abanikwa loo mprofeti kwiminyaka yakhe yokugqibela.
Ndinconywa kwiQuran ngokuba ndithembekile kwilizwi lam.
Ndandiphethe imbeko yobuprofeti kwaye ndathunywa njengomthunywa.
Ndajoyina utata ekuphakamiseni iziseko zeNdlu eNgcwele.
Ndikhunjulwa njengomnye wabantu ababenomonde, kwaye indlu engcwele esayakhayo yaba yindawo yokubuyela nokhuseleko ebantwini.
arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
